newer_changes_search: Searched samajkalyan.up.gov.in and the web; read the UP Budget 2026-27 highlights. The GO of 23 May 2025 has a corrupted text layer: its numerals are legible (3.00 lakh, 60,000, 25,000, 15,000, 1,00,000) and match the portal, but I could not read its clauses word by word. Patrika (Jul 2026) repeats ₹1 lakh with ₹60,000 to the account.

findings.note: UP Budget 2026-27 highlights say the grant rose "from ₹51,000 to ₹1.01 lakh", while the order and department page give ₹1,00,000 (60,000 + 25,000 + 15,000). The order is the better source and the parts add up, but the conflict is unexplained.
findings.suggestion: Keep ₹1,00,000 and record the discrepancy for the next re-check.

findings.note: The quote stops at "daughters from economically weaker families", while the rule text also covers the applicant's own remarriage.
findings.suggestion: Extend the quote to "and in the remarriage of widows, abandoned women, and divorced women".

findings.note: The objective also names abandoned women, but section 4 lists only legally divorced and widowed women. The content follows section 4, the safer reading.
findings.suggestion: Check the order and add abandoned women if it covers them.

findings.note: Address proof, listed in section 5, is missing.
findings.suggestion: Add it if a document code exists.
